{
  "name": "ruflo-sparc",
  "description": "SPARC methodology — Specification, Pseudocode, Architecture, Refinement, Completion phases with gate checks",
  "version": "0.3.4",
  "author": {
    "name": "ruvnet",
    "url": "https://github.com/ruvnet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "ruflo",
    "sparc",
    "methodology",
    "specification",
    "architecture",
    "refinement",
    "mcp",
    "phase-gates",
    "quality-gates",
    "function-hooks",
    "guard"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "guard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Secret guard",
      "description": "Refuse specs and phase artifacts that hold a secret in sparc namespaces.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
